cultural_reasoning: AI safety stress-test of chain-of-thought monitorability; no cultural or language focus.
survey_reasoning: Contributes a quantifiable obfuscation-pressure taxonomy and evaluation protocol, and systematically tests whether reasoning models can hide malicious objectives from CoT monitors (deception/safety).
what_measures: Whether reasoning models can pursue hidden adversarial side tasks while hiding them from chain-of-thought monitors, comparing internal and external CoT.

dataset_size: 12 toy task pairs plus 3 SHADE-Arena task pairs; 150 trials per condition
models_evaluated: Claude Sonnet 3.7, Claude Sonnet 4 (agents); GPT-5 mini, GPT-4o mini, GPT-4o, GPT-5 (evaluator/monitors)
